title: FrameCapability
description: What content framed by the EPR chrome may be given beyond running its own scripts. A record declares the capabilities it requests (html5-app contentBody.capabilities); the chrome gives the declared set within the standing ceiling, as the person narrows or grants it. Scripts are never a capability: a trustful frame always runs scripts, and whether it also keeps its own origin (allow-same-origin) is decided by the chrome from mode and isolation, never declared here. Each value carries three annotations the generators project into the chrome's table and the doorway's Permissions-Policy ceiling: x-sandbox (the iframe sandbox token it adds, or null), x-allow (the Permissions-Policy feature it enables in the iframe allow attribute, or null), x-device (true when it reaches the person's device and so is only ever given by the person's own grant). Source of truth: this schema (vocabulary only, Category C) — it stores nothing and is not notarized; the declared set lives in the html5-app record's contentBody, which the integrity zome treats as opaque, so this vocabulary never moves a DNA hash.

_source.rationale: Frame capabilities are a presentation-edge vocabulary shared by the record's declaration, the chrome's frame attributes and the doorway's ceiling; the record that declares them is notarized, the vocabulary is not

oneOf.description: Opened windows stay inside the sandbox: allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox is never given.
